text:
nate: Friendly heads-up: v2.8 cutoff is TOMORROW 1700 PT. Quick checklist below — post status or blockers.

nate: Checklist:
- backports merged to release/v2.8
- submodules pinned to commits
- vendor/ regenerated (go mod vendor / yarn install --frozen-lockfile)
- lockfiles committed (go.sum, package-lock.json, yarn.lock)
- run ./scripts/vendor-sanity.sh and ./scripts/verify-submodules.sh
- CI green + security scan

mira: Working on the protobuf/vendor bump PR (https://git.redwood/repo/pull/3278). CI flaky on ios-interop test. Investigating; ETA ~2h.

leo: I have a small sqlite C-bind update that touches vendor/ and will require lock regen. Holding the change until backports land. Local sanity run shows one unused file. Will drop it.

ana: I pushed the mem-fix backport to a branch and opened PR to release/v2.8 (https://git.redwood/repo/pull/3280). Note: it modifies build flags; merge it before vendor regen.

jin: release-bot: preflight checks queued: env, deps-sum, license-scan.

mira: Quick note: protobuf bump includes generated proto changes. If anyone pulls locally, run:
```
make gen-protos && git add -A && git commit -m "chore(proto): regen after vendor"
```

leo: Running vendor sanity:
```
$ ./scripts/vendor-sanity.sh
OK: license headers present
WARN: vendor/legacy_patch.diff (should be removed)
```
I'll remove legacy_patch.diff before pushing.

ana: @leo also run `git submodule foreach --recursive 'git rev-parse HEAD'` to ensure no submodules point to branch refs. We've had a slip last time.

leo: Good call. Submodule check: all pinned. One nested submodule had a detached HEAD but a commit hash is present. I'll include `git submodule status` output in the PR description.

mira: CI re-run on PR #3278 shows the ios-interop failure is a timeout in the mock server. I added a retry in the test harness. Re-running.

release-bot: license-scan: OK; deps-sum: mismatch detected for yarn.lock vs package.json. Please regen lockfile before merging.

nate: Maria from docs will assemble changelog entries after merges. Please add `changelog: short one-line` to PR descriptions.

maria: I'll be watching. If you forget changelog lines, ping me and I'll draft from commits but it's slower.

leo: Opening PR now to release/v2.8 with vendor changes and lockfile regen. Commands I used:
```
git checkout -b release/sqlite-vendor-fix release/v2.8
./scripts/update-vendor.sh && go mod tidy && go mod vendor
npm ci && npm run build && git add vendor/ go.sum yarn.lock package-lock.json && git commit -m "chore: vendor sqlite binding + regen locks"
git push origin HEAD:release/v2.8
```
Link: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/3283

mira: CI green on #3278. Tagging it `after-backports`. Ready to merge after ana's backport.

ana: Merged backport to release/v2.8 (merge commit: a1d4f7e). Dropping note here.

nate: Plan of action (confirm):
1) merge backport (done)
2) merge mira proto/vendor bump (#3278)
3) merge leo vendor + lock regen (#3283)
4) run full pre-release smoke + security scan
5) release-manager creates rc tag and runs staging smoke

mira: Confirmed. I'll rebase onto release/v2.8 now and request review.

release-bot: reminder: ensure no branch refs in .gitmodules. Use `git config -f .gitmodules --list` to verify.

leo: Addressed the unused file and fixed .gitmodules entries. PR #3283 updated.

jin: release-bot: security-scan queued. Note: base image has a low CVE flagged; not blocking but add to post-release patch list.

release-manager: I'll tag once the two PRs are merged and CI + scans are green. I will also kick off staged smoke; target tagging within 15 minutes after merges.

maria: Docs request: please include short changelog lines in PRs now. Example: `changelog: fix: prevent KV cache double-free in edge case (backport)`.

mira: Merged #3278. All green on CI. Added changelog line to PR description.

leo: Merged #3283 and pushed regenerated locks. Verified `git submodule status` shows pinned SHAs. Added `vendor-sanity` output to PR.

release-manager: Created tag v2.8.0-rc1 (tag githash: b9e3c5a). Staging smoke started (job 4521).

nate: Thanks everyone. I'll keep this thread open until smoke passes. If anything fails, reply here so release-manager can hold the tag.
